sources.quote: 1977-1978 ... 1/27 Connecticut N42 W, 76-63 ... 1/28 Massachusetts N42 W, 78-63
Colonial Classic J 27 BG Massachusetts L 64-88 J 28 BG Connecticut W 101-72

note: Holy Cross's own all-time results list the 1/27/78 UConn game at neutral site N42 = Colonial Classic, Boston Garden (not Worcester); BC's record book shows the same two-night Colonial Classic at Boston Garden (BC-UMass 1/27, BC-UConn 1/28). Record book (N) is right; app's A is wrong. Side note: Holy Cross prints the score as 76-63, while UConn's record book and the app have 78-63 - score not settled here.

sources.quote: 1977-78 (15-11) H: 6-3 A: 5-4 N: 4-4 ... Colonial Classic ... J 28 BG Connecticut W 101-72
1/27 Connecticut N42 W, 76-63 ... 1/28 Massachusetts N42 W, 78-63

note: BC's record book lists the game under 'Colonial Classic' at BG (Boston Garden), and its 1977-78 home/away/neutral split (N: 4-4) only adds up if both Colonial Classic games are counted neutral; its series list gives Boston, Mass. rather than Chestnut Hill. Holy Cross's results confirm the event at Boston Garden that weekend. Record book (N) is right; app's A is wrong.

sources.quote: 1/26 Connecticut (ot) N42 L, 102-109 ... 1/27 Massachusetts N42 W, 78-74
109-102 overtime loss to Connecticut in the Colonial Classic. The 46 points were a Boston Garden collegiate record.
Colonial Classic J 26 BG Massachusetts W 82-70 J 27 BG Connecticut W 78-77

note: Holy Cross's all-time results put the 1/26/79 game at N42 (Colonial Classic, Boston Garden), and its fact-book chronology calls Ronnie Perry's 46 points a Boston Garden collegiate record. BC's record book shows the same event at Boston Garden on 1/26-27/79. Record book (N) is right; app's A is wrong.

sources.quote: Jan. 26, 1979: Perry scores a career-high 46 points in a 109-102 overtime loss to Connecticut

note: Holy Cross's results list and its fact-book chronology both call the 109-102 game an overtime loss to UConn. Record book (OT) is right; app is missing the OT.
